name: Signed-Bouquet Characterization
statement: An ample $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^E$ belongs to this graph class exactly when some coordinate flip makes it intersection-closed; equivalently, some $r\in C$ satisfies $\operatorname{maj}(u,v,r)\in C$ for every $u,v\in C$. After normalizing its minimum to zero, it contains the empty set and every $A\subsetneq B$ in the family has a one-element extension of $A$ contained in $B$.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample families, up to signed-coordinate isometries and suppression of constants.
